table.name: Examination
table.purpose: Clinical/laboratory examination records for autoimmune disease patients (rheumatology cohort, ~1989-1998), capturing antinuclear antibody results, antiphospholipid antibody tests, lupus anticoagulant assays, thrombosis history, and diagnoses such as SLE, Sjögren's syndrome, and rheumatoid arthritis. One row = one examination of one patient (ID likely links to Patient).

ANA.name: ANA titer (reciprocal dilution)
ANA.description: Antinuclear antibody titer, expressed as reciprocal dilution values (0, 4, 16, 64, 256, ... 4096), i.e. doubling dilutions; 0 = negative.

ANA Pattern.name: ANA staining pattern
ANA Pattern.description: Immunofluorescence staining pattern of the ANA test, comma-separated codes; S likely = speckled, P = peripheral/rim, D = diffuse/homogeneous (plausible reading; exact code legend not in data).

Diagnosis.name: Diagnosis
Diagnosis.description: Clinical diagnosis, abbreviated: SLE = systemic lupus erythematosus, SjS = Sjögren's syndrome, RA = rheumatoid arthritis, MCTD = mixed connective tissue disease, DM = dermatomyositis; 'susp' = suspected; multiple diagnoses comma-separated. Null = no/undocumented diagnosis.

Examination Date.name: Examination date
Examination Date.description: Date of the examination (stored as text, YYYY-MM-DD), ranging 1989-04-18 to 1998-04-17.

ID.name: Patient identifier
ID.description: Highly unique numeric ID, most likely the patient identifier linking to the Patient table (no join detected, but 763 distinct values over 806 rows suggests repeated examinations per patient).

KCT.name: Kaolin clotting time result
KCT.description: Lupus anticoagulant test via kaolin clotting time; '+' positive, '-' negative; mostly null (test not always performed).

LAC.name: Lupus anticoagulant result
LAC.description: Lupus anticoagulant test overall result; '+' positive, '-' negative; mostly null when not tested.

RVVT.name: Russell viper venom time result
RVVT.description: Lupus anticoagulant test via dilute Russell viper venom time; '+' positive, '-' negative; mostly null when not tested.

Symptoms.name: Clinical symptoms/complications
Symptoms.description: Free-text clinical manifestations, mostly thrombotic/obstetric events consistent with antiphospholipid syndrome: CNS lupus, brain infarction, AMI (acute myocardial infarction), PH (pulmonary hypertension?), thrombocytopenia, DVT, thrombophlebitis, abortion. Mostly null.

Thrombosis.name: Thrombosis count
Thrombosis.description: Number of thrombotic events (0-3); 0 = none, higher values = multiple episodes.

aCL IgA.name: Anticardiolipin IgA level
aCL IgA.description: Anticardiolipin antibody IgA level (units not documented; likely GPL/MPL-like units); 0 = negative, extreme max 48547 suggests occasional very high titers.

aCL IgG.name: Anticardiolipin IgG level
aCL IgG.description: Anticardiolipin antibody IgG level (likely GPL units); 0 = negative.

aCL IgM.name: Anticardiolipin IgM level
aCL IgM.description: Anticardiolipin antibody IgM level (likely MPL units); 0 = negative, extreme max 187122 suggests occasional very high titers.

table.name: Laboratory
table.purpose: Laboratory test results per patient visit (one row per patient per date), covering blood counts, blood chemistry, urinalysis, coagulation, immunoglobulins, complement, and autoantibody tests. The panel (anti-DNA, anti-Sm, anti-RNP, anti-SSA/SSB, anti-centromere, C3/C4, RA test, RF) strongly suggests a rheumatology/autoimmune disease (likely SLE) cohort. Links to Patient via ID and presumably to Examination by patient/date.

ALB.name: Serum albumin
ALB.description: Albumin, g/dL (range 1.0-5.8, typical 3.5-5.0). Low values consistent with nephrotic-range proteinuria in autoimmune disease.

APTT.name: Activated partial thromboplastin time
APTT.description: APTT, seconds (range 57-146, median ~95; prolonged vs normal ~25-35, consistent with lupus anticoagulant screening). Measured in <1% of rows.

C3.name: Complement component C3
C3.description: Serum C3, mg/dL (range 15-196, median ~69; low levels typical of SLE activity).

C4.name: Complement component C4
C4.description: Serum C4, mg/dL (range 3-80, median ~21; low in SLE).

CENTROMEA.name: Anti-centromere antibody
CENTROMEA.description: Anti-centromere antibody result; values 'negative'/'0' (and possibly titer-style numbers). Almost never measured (99.9% null).

CPK.name: Creatine phosphokinase (CK)
CPK.description: CPK, U/L (range 0-10835, median ~35; high values indicate muscle involvement such as myositis).

CRE.name: Serum creatinine
CRE.description: Creatinine, mg/dL (range 0.1-17.1, median 0.7; high values reflect renal failure).

CRP.name: C-reactive protein
CRP.description: CRP result; stored inconsistently as semi-quantitative ('-', '+', '2+') and numeric strings with limits ('<0.3', '2.18'). Mixed-format inflammation marker, mg/dL when numeric.

DNA.name: Anti-dsDNA antibody
DNA.description: Anti-double-stranded DNA antibody titer/value (range 0.56-185, median ~23). Measured in <1% of rows; characteristic SLE marker.

DNA-II.name: Anti-dsDNA antibody (second method)
DNA-II.description: Second anti-dsDNA antibody column, likely a repeat or alternative assay alongside DNA; plausibly a different measurement method (e.g., RIA vs. IF), but no direct evidence distinguishes it from a duplicate entry of the same test.

FG.name: Fibrinogen
FG.description: Fibrinogen, likely mg/dL in tens (range 23.8-106.5, median 39) — possibly recorded in units of 10 mg/dL given normal fibrinogen 200-400 mg/dL. Measured in ~3% of rows. Alternative reading: values in µmol/L (normal 6-12), which fits less well.

HGB.name: Hemoglobin
HGB.description: Hemoglobin, g/dL (range 1.3-18.9, median 12.5; anemia common in this cohort).

ID.name: Patient ID
ID.description: Identifier of the patient; references Patient.ID (many lab rows per patient; 302 distinct patients over 13908 rows).

IGG.name: Serum IgG
IGG.description: Immunoglobulin G, mg/dL (range 3-6510, median ~1666; elevated in autoimmune disease).

PT.name: Prothrombin time
PT.description: Prothrombin time, seconds (range 10.1-27, median ~12.4). Measured in ~4.5% of rows.

RA.name: RA test (rheumatoid factor latex agglutination)
RA.description: Semi-quantitative rheumatoid arthritis test result: '-', '+-', '+', '2+' (one stray '7-' likely data entry error).

RF.name: Rheumatoid factor
RF.description: RF titer/value, IU or U/mL; stored as text with '<' limit values ('<40', '<20.5') and numerics (up to ~98).

RNP.name: Anti-RNP antibody
RNP.description: Anti-ribonucleoprotein antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer-style numbers (1, 4, 16, 64, 256 — doubling-dilution titers).

SC170.name: Anti-Scl-70 antibody
SC170.description: Anti-Scl-70 (topoisomerase I) antibody, scleroderma marker: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 4, 16). Almost never measured.

SM.name: Anti-Sm antibody
SM.description: Anti-Smith antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 2, 8). SLE-specific marker, rarely measured.

SSA.name: Anti-SSA/Ro antibody
SSA.description: Anti-SSA (Ro) antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 16, 64, 256).

SSB.name: Anti-SSB/La antibody
SSB.description: Anti-SSB (La) antibody result: 'negative'/'0' or titer numbers (1, 2, 32).

U-PRO.name: Urine protein
U-PRO.description: Urinary protein (dipstick/quantitative): '-', '0', 'TR' (trace), numeric amounts, '>=1000' (mg/dL), and stray '%%' entry error.

table.name: Patient
table.purpose: Rheumatology patient registry: one row per patient with demographics, diagnosis, and key visit dates; referenced by Laboratory results and presumably Examination records.

Admission.name: Admission
Admission.description: Admission status flag: '-' (outpatient/not admitted, 713), '+' (admitted, 488), '+(' (admitted with parenthetical note, 3), blank (unknown, 34). Alternative reading: could mark whether the patient was hospitalized at the time of the recorded visit rather than a general status.

Description.name: Description date
Description.description: A date despite the name; 1991-1998 range, low uniqueness, 17% null. Likely the date of a clinical description/case report entry, but the exact event is unresolved; no joined column clarifies it.

Diagnosis.name: Diagnosis
Diagnosis.description: Primary diagnosis, mostly rheumatic/autoimmune disease abbreviations: SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus), SJS (Sjögren's syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis), Behçet's, PSS (progressive systemic sclerosis), DM (dermatomyositis), PN (polyarteritis nodosa). Free text, may list multiple diagnoses.

First Date.name: First visit / first presentation date
First Date.description: Date of the patient's first visit or disease onset record (1972-1998), 20% null. Could alternatively be the date of first presentation at this registry rather than disease onset; Laboratory rows are keyed by patient and date but do not disambiguate this.

ID.name: Patient ID
ID.description: Primary key; unique patient identifier, referenced by Laboratory.ID.

SEX.name: Sex
SEX.description: Patient sex: F (1023), M (202), blank (13). Strong female predominance consistent with autoimmune disease cohort.
